segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ לֹא יֹאמַר אָדָם לַטַּבָּח: שְׁקוֹל לִי בְּדִינָר בָּשָׂר, אֲבָל שׁוֹחֵט וּמְחַלֵּק בֵּינֵיהֶם.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A person» may «not say to a butcher» on a Festival: «Weigh for me a dinar’s worth of meat,» since if he mentions a sum of money, it looks like a commercial transaction. «But» the butcher may «slaughter» an animal «and apportion it» among his customers without stipulating a price.

moves.summary: no price mention; slaughter and apportion

positions.claim: may not ask for a dinar's worth; the butcher may slaughter and apportion
